title: The page lifts at tablet width

prompts.precise: In style.css, the hidden #announce element (.sr-only, position: absolute) inside #list is placed against #desk, which is position: relative between 761 and 1100 px; that makes #desk scrollable, and the scrollIntoView in Add lifts the page. Fix it.
prompts.everyday: In index.html, at a window 1024 px wide, once the list is long, clicking Add lifts the whole page and leaves an empty band at the bottom. At 1440 px it is fine. Find the cause and fix it.
prompts.vague: The page jumps up and leaves a gap at the bottom when I add things.
